guidance: Navigate to the first receptacle exactly as it appears in the initial room observation text. If it is a closed storage receptacle, open it and inspect for the target object. If it is an open surface, inspect directly. Take the target if found; otherwise halt the local probe after this single inspection.
hypothesis: Strictly following the textual listing order from the initial room observation, rather than prioritizing receptacles by type (open vs. closed), provides a reliable baseline search strategy that avoids heuristic mispredictions about object placement.

probe_spec.adaptive_policy: Identify the first receptacle named in the entry observation text. Issue a navigation action to that receptacle. Upon arrival, if the observation indicates it is closed, issue an open action. Inspect the resulting observation for the target object type. If present, issue a take action. If absent or if any action fails, halt the probe immediately without proceeding to subsequent receptacles.
probe_spec.evidence_goal: Whether the target object is found at the first textually listed receptacle, establishing if strict listing-order search succeeds on the first attempt compared to type-prioritized heuristics tested previously.
probe_spec.local_function: Navigate to and inspect the first receptacle in the exact textual listing order from the room observation.
probe_spec.realization_pattern: Select the first receptacle mentioned in the initial room description regardless of its type, navigate to it, open it if it is a closed storage receptacle, inspect for the target object, and take it if present; otherwise halt the local probe.
probe_spec.required_downstream_state: Agent holds the target object in inventory if found, or remains at room center with empty inventory if not found, preserving the ability to continue searching other receptacles.
stop_conditions: Target object is successfully taken into inventory.
Navigation to the first listed receptacle fails.
The first listed receptacle is inspected and does not contain the target object.
An open action fails on a closed storage receptacle.

reason: Previous explorations tested type-based prioritization (open surfaces first or closed storage first). This probe tests the incumbent's strict textual-listing-order constraint by inspecting only the very first mentioned receptacle, providing a discriminative baseline comparison against those earlier type-heuristic experiments.
scope: ALFWorld pick-clean-then-place tasks where the target object is not immediately visible at room center and both open surface and closed storage receptacles are listed in the entry observation.

public_capability_evidence: Entry observation lists cabinet_4 first among visible receptacles.
Historical capability vocabulary includes 'go to', 'open', and 'take' action schemas.
source_grounding.why_grounded: cabinet_4 is the first receptacle explicitly listed in the entry observation text ('you see cabinet_4, cabinet_3, ...') and 'go to cabinet_4' is present in the admissible actions list.
